lines.t: Lost in the quiet of my broken soul
I wander through shadows, chasing control
Empty promises burned and disappeared
To yahoo's shoe whispered, I am still here
Your light cuts through the dark, I knew
Every fear fades when I see you
You're my eternal glow
Burning through every moment slow
When the world turns cold, you shine below
Yahushua, my eternal glow
I felt the fire in the cold rainfall
I tried to stand but lost it all
Then your mercy found me in disguise
Rocked and worn beneath your skies
I see reflections of grace unfold
Down in night into threads of gold
You're my eternal glow
With my heart in heaven flow
When I lose my way, you make it show
You're my eternal glow
In the ruins you build something new From ashes to colors bright and true
The light you give no world can steal It's more than feeling, it's how I heal
Your glow, it breathes inside my chest Every beat reminds me I'm blessed
Past the stars, past time below You shine through all I'll ever know
Know my eternal glow
Through every season
High or low
Yeah, who's to what when my spirit slows
You're waking life
When mercy flows
Just like dawn across the years
Your light dissolves the weight of fears
I'll keep walking where you show
Forever yours, my eternal glow
Thanks for watching!
